|errata_history=[[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]] Appendix A — Errata (PDF dated 30 July 2023): LOST: “Each player places hand onto Reserve Deck (if possible), then places Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws cards from Reserve Deck equal to the number of cards just placed from hand onto Reserve Deck (if any).” (print: “Each player counts cards in hand, then places entire hand and Used Pile onto Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Each player then draws from Reserve Deck the counted number of cards to create a new hand.”). The same wording is already in the Players Committee ''Decipher Errata'' sheet ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf], “Official text as of June 1, 2017”; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210802154149/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]), the earliest source found; the date the Players Committee first issued this change is not established. Printed text: [[Sense & Uncertain Is The Future]].
